title: Implementation Roadmap
description:
Stage 9 artifact for the business_requirement path (FR-036, AI §9.1). Generated against the Stage 6 architecture and the context set.

EVERY PHASE NAMES WHAT IT BUILDS, WHAT IT DEPENDS ON, AND WHAT EXISTS WHEN IT IS DONE. FR-036 states all three. The components are names from the architecture (AI §9.4 shared vocabulary); the pipeline refuses a phase naming a component the design does not have, a dependency on a later phase, and a roadmap that leaves a component of the design unbuilt.

An estimate is optional and, when present, cites the context element that supplied its basis: FR-036 permits no calendar estimate the input gave no basis for.

ordinal.description: 1 to n, in the order the phases are given.

objective.description: What this phase sets out to do, in terms of the design.

components.description: Architecture component names this phase builds or extends, copied exactly.

depends_on.description: Ordinals of earlier phases this one requires. Empty for a phase that can start first.

outcome.description: What exists, and works, at the end of this phase.

basis_context_index.description: The context element that supplied the basis for the estimate.

sequencing_rationale.description: Why the phases are in this order, in terms of the design's dependencies.
